about_short_description.short_description: CodeViz uses an AI agent to create interactive maps of codebases, making it easier for engineers to understand and navigate.

product.name: Codebase Maps
product.description: Automatically generated interactive maps of codebases that allow engineers to explore and understand code structure and flow at multiple levels.

product.name: Query-Based Code Analysis
product.description: A feature that allows users to perform codebase analysis by querying in natural language, providing targeted insights and navigation.

product.name: Export Diagrams
product.description: Allows users to export visual diagrams of codebase architecture and flows for documentation or sharing purposes.

product.name: Live Query Suggestions
product.description: Provides real-time suggestions for queries to help users interact with their codebase more effectively.

product.name: LLM Prompt Generation
product.description: Generates prompts for large language models to facilitate advanced codebase analysis and interaction.

identifier.value: Git Pull Request & Issue Tracking Integration

product.name: Git Pull Request & Issue Tracking Integration
product.description: Integrates with Git to track pull requests and issues directly within the codebase visualization environment.
